services.sub: Every treatment is customized to your skin, whether your goal is age management, acne, rosacea, hyperpigmentation, or a stronger skin barrier. Science-backed care with results that hold up long after your visit.

science.heading: Personalized treatments. Healthier skin.
science.body:
You don’t have to know which treatment is right for you. That’s our job.

Every appointment starts with a real skin consultation. We look at your skin, talk through your concerns and goals, and build a plan made for you, whether that’s **age management, acne, rosacea, hyperpigmentation, or skin barrier repair**.

Using treatments like **Glo2Facial®, Jet Plasma®, BioRePeel®, ProCell® Microchanneling, and custom corrective facials**, we work on how your skin functions, so results keep improving over time.

**Healthy skin ages better.**

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Every journey begins with a personalized skin consultation. We’ll evaluate your skin, discuss your goals, and identify what’s contributing to your concerns so we can create a treatment plan tailored specifically to you.

steps.title: Customize
steps.text: Using advanced corrective skincare treatments and professional-grade products, we build a customized plan designed to improve your skin’s function, not just its appearance. Every recommendation is based on your unique skin, not a one-size-fits-all facial.

steps.title: Transform
steps.text: Through consistency, expert guidance, and treatments tailored to your skin, you’ll experience healthier, stronger, more resilient skin with results that continue to improve long after your appointment.

results.heading: Real results. Healthier skin.
results.body:
We specialize in **corrective skincare and age management** that improves your skin’s health, not just how it looks. Every plan is built around your concerns, from **fine lines and acne to rosacea, hyperpigmentation, and texture**.

Treatments like **Glo2Facial®, Jet Plasma®, BioRePeel®, and ProCell® Microchanneling** stimulate collagen, calm inflammation, and strengthen the skin barrier. Real change comes from consistent, personalized care, not a single facial.

about.heading: Healthy skin starts here. Personalized care.
about.body:
At **Polished Skin in Eugene, Oregon**, we believe healthy skin ages better.

Founded by licensed esthetician **Analisa Hickey**, Polished Skin is a corrective skincare studio focused on **age management, rosacea, acne, hyperpigmentation, and skin barrier repair**. The idea is simple: improve how your skin functions, and it looks healthier on its own.

**Our promise to every client**

- A treatment plan built specifically for your skin.
- Science-backed care that puts skin health over quick fixes.
- Straight answers, so you understand _why_ your skin does what it does.
- Lasting results through consistency and expert care.
